ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible fluke; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse and localized.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform black pigmentation with small, high-contrast light mottling clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch dividing the lobes with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with higher frequency and pixel-amplitude peaks located at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward and outward sweep following a slight convex curve from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized small, high-contrast white circular spots visible on the distal regions of both lobes, particularly the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the upper left lobe and a single horizontal linear mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable linear rake marks on the left lobe; jagged, irregular distal tip boundaries suggestive of previous trauma.
